fusions.name: Short Leash
fusions.desc: Hooks an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and binds it, slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hopping Links
fusions.desc: Flicks a hooked claw at the first enemy in line for 4 damage; it hops on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Slip the Collar
fusions.desc: You are immune to blows and conditions for 3 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Taut
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 7% more damage per stack (33% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
